callaway-elyte: Long, forgiving and often wins fittings; a few crowns cracked.
callaway-elyte-mini: More fairways for about 10 yards less; a few crowns cracked.
callaway-elyte-triple-diamond: Lower spin and tighter dispersion; fade biased and hard to launch.
callaway-quantum-mini: Straighter off the tee with little distance lost.
callaway-quantum-triple-diamond: Lower spin and more distance once fitted; pricey for the gain.
callaway-quantum-triple-diamond-max: Longer and lower spinning yet forgiving; loud or hard for a few.
cobra-ds-adapt-max-k: Keeps mishits in play and costs less; some note a draw bias.
cobra-ds-adapt-x: Adjustable and more forgiving than expected; one missed both ways.
ping-g430-max: Easy to hit straight and helps slicers; too much spin for some.
ping-g430-max-10k: Tames big slices and finds fairways; many report cracked crowns.
ping-g440-k: Mishits stay in play and slices are tamed; a bit shorter on good hits.
ping-g440-max: Very forgiving and straight; not always longest on centre hits.
taylormade-qi35-ls: Low spin and tight dispersion; several faces popped within weeks.
taylormade-qi35-max: Long and forgiving, wins fittings; early cracks are the main gripe.
taylormade-qi4d: Long, straight and forgiving at fittings; a few couldn't hit it.
taylormade-qi4d-ls: Low spin and faster ball speed; harder to hit than the Max.
taylormade-r7-quad-mini: Much straighter than a driver for 10 to 15 yards less.
titleist-gt2: Longer, straighter and great feel; cracked crowns are common.
titleist-gt280-mini: Much straighter than a driver and easy off the deck; a bit shorter.
titleist-gt3: Long, low spin and great feel; less forgiving, with some snap hooks.
titleist-gts2: Very forgiving on off-centre strikes; one doubts the gain over a GT2.
callaway-quantum-max: Draw bias helps slicers find fairways; some still slice it.
ping-g430-lst: Long and tight when fitted well; several cracked heads or crowns.
callaway-elyte-x: Straighter with lower spin than an old driver; some still slice.
titleist-gt4: Low spin for those who need it; a few report cracked heads.
ping-g430-sft: Straight and forgiving, with mishits that still go; a bit loud.
cobra-ds-adapt-ls: Low spin and fast ball speed; a few heads buckled or shattered.
